scope: Initial synthetic PDF document viewport on macOS arm64; one retained AppKit candidate and final Electron candidate, no installed application/service interaction.

capture.appkit: Native CUA window screenshot, JPEG; untouched initial page layout; inactive window. Requested 1200x820-point window was constrained by the current display.
capture.electron: Actual packaged renderer CDP screenshot, PNG; viewport emulated at matching size/scale; full page/zoom controls admitted before capture; native OS titlebar excluded.

isolation.appkit: Copied retained bundle; unique local.placekeeper.paired-appearance.20261102b bundle identifier; URL/document handler metadata removed; original executable and resources unchanged; private HOME/service root.
isolation.electron: InstalledCandidate harness with disposable isolated test root, isolated Electron user-data, independent test daemon and copied fixture.
isolation.cleanup: Both test app/daemon pairs stopped before performance measurements; installed app, installed service and default handlers were not operated.

observed: Both captures show fixture page 1, the Introduction heading, and the same paragraph text, line wrapping, page width and horizontal placement.
The document raster begins 4 device pixels (2 CSS points) higher in Electron; comparison applies only that measured vertical translation and no scale/warp.
Shared shell CSS hashes match exactly; host entry JavaScript differs as expected.
Electron transport reported no runtime errors in this capture.
interpretation: Within the stated document-text crop, thresholded dark-ink overlap is 86.5304% without edge tolerance after translation; with a one-device-pixel neighborhood, 99.9950% of AppKit ink and 100% of Electron ink are covered. This supports matching visible page content/layout in this case, while retaining the raw unequal pixels.
limitations: One synthetic PDF page, initial fit-width layout, one local macOS host; no cross-platform, corpus-wide, multi-state or full native-shell appearance qualification.
AppKit capture is lossy JPEG and Electron capture is lossless PNG; no byte/pixel identity claim or visual pass threshold is asserted.

Native traffic lights, toolbar title inset, window activation and hover/focus state differ; Electron native titlebar is outside its renderer screenshot, so the whole-window pixel metric is descriptive rather than an equivalence test.
Menus, workspace-open layouts, authoring dialogs and matching toolbar-hover states were not paired.
The retained AppKit and final Electron bundles have different service/runtime versions and distinct host JavaScript; their exact identities/assets are retained in the metadata.

comparisonMethod.decoder: Playwright 1.61.1 bundled PNG decoder; native JPEG converted to PNG by macOS sips without resizing
comparisonMethod.rawRegions: RGB absolute channel differences at identical coordinates; channel >16 counts shown separately.
comparisonMethod.ink: Red channel <128 within x=300..2199,y=200..1099 device pixels; exhaustively select highest intersection-over-union from dx=-4..4,dy=-12..12; report translation, then symmetric one-pixel neighborhood coverage.
